7.3.2.3 Usage
To use modeled messages, an ARXML file can be used for generating header files
which include constexpr variables within corresponding namespaces.
For instance, if the ARXML representation of the manifest contains the following:
<AR-PACKAGES>
<AR-PACKAGE>
<SHORT-NAME>
AUTOSAR
</SHORT-NAME>
<ELEMENTS>
<LOG-AND-TRACE-INTERFACE>
<SHORT-NAME>
LogAndTraceInterface
</SHORT-NAME>
<NAMESPACES>
<SYMBOL-PROPS>
<SHORT-NAME>
apd
</SHORT-NAME>
<SYMBOL>
apd
</SYMBOL>
</SYMBOL-PROPS>
<SYMBOL-PROPS>
<SHORT-NAME>
myapp
</SHORT-NAME>
<SYMBOL>
myapp
</SYMBOL>
